We have workbook Sheet1. Answer range C4:F6. Existing table: B3:F3 headers? B3 null, C3 A, D3 B, E3 C, F3 D. B4 x, B5 y, B6 z. Data I3:K22: I v/w/x/y/z, J A/B/C/D, K values. Need return value from third column (K) by matching two columns: row label B (x/y/z) and column header C-F (A-D). So for each C4:F6, lookup in I:K where I = row label (B4) and J = column header (C3). Need formula. Could use INDEX/MATCH array: =INDEX($K$4:$K$22, MATCH(1, ($I$4:$I$22=$B4)*($J$4:$J$22=C$3), 0)) as array formula. Or SUMIFS: =SUMIFS($K$4:$K$22, $I$4:$I$22, $B4, $J$4:$J$22, C$3). When fill to F6, $B4 becomes B5/B6, C$3 becomes D$3/E$3/F$3. Good.

Need ensure destination wholly inside answer ranges. Use fill_formula range C4:F6. Operation only one. Summary. JSON exactly.
